selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the first gain mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: A temporary life becomes lasting when it is used for Allah’s sake.

questions.question: What do the passing moments of life become in the hereafter?
questions.answer: They become lasting fruits of blessing and happiness.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens to each body part and sense in the third profit?
questions.answer: Its value becomes much greater.

questions.question: Why does the passage say some sinful people run to drinking or useless fun?
questions.answer: They want to escape the pain and pressure caused by their troubled minds.

questions.question: What temptation makes the eye fall from its proper place?
questions.answer: Chasing a few temporary beauties out of desire.

questions.question: How is the tongue lowered when it serves only appetite?
questions.answer: It becomes nothing more than a servant for the stomach.

questions.question: What are readers told to do with the other limbs and abilities not named one by one?
questions.answer: Compare them to these examples and understand the same rule applies.

questions.question: What is the healthy response to this weakness?
questions.answer: To depend on Allah, trust Him, and submit to Him.

questions.question: What happens inside a person who does not do this?
questions.answer: The conscience remains restless and overwhelmed.

questions.question: Who agrees on this fifth gain according to the passage?
questions.answer: People of spiritual insight who have seen the truth of things.

questions.question: Into what does the passage say temporary property is changed in the first gain?
questions.answer: It is changed into something everlasting.

questions.question: What natural example helps explain how brief deeds can have lasting results?
questions.answer: Seeds that later grow into flowers.

questions.question: What is intelligence compared to at the start of its example?
questions.answer: A useful instrument.

questions.question: When intelligence is used for Allah, what does it help open?
questions.answer: It helps a person understand the hidden treasures of mercy and wisdom in creation.

questions.question: What destination does such a rightly used mind help prepare for?
questions.answer: Eternal happiness.

questions.question: What body part is linked with taste in the next example?
questions.answer: The tongue.

questions.question: Why does the passage directly call on intelligence, eye, and tongue?
questions.answer: To make the reader notice the huge difference between low use and noble use.

questions.question: What kind of inner nature does faith build in a believer?
questions.answer: One suitable for Paradise.

questions.question: What protects a person from being crushed by life according to the passage?
questions.answer: Dependence on Allah through trust and submission.

questions.question: According to the fifth gain, when will the reward of worship be especially important?
questions.answer: At the time of greatest need.

questions.question: What change happens to a short worldly life in the first profit?
questions.answer: It gains an everlasting result.

questions.question: Besides the eternal world, where else do those good results show a comforting side?
questions.answer: In the Intermediate Realm.

questions.question: What does the third profit teach about the human body and senses?
questions.answer: Their value rises greatly when they are used in the right way.

questions.question: What behavior is mentioned as an escape from that pain?
questions.answer: Turning to intoxicants or pointless entertainment.
